Class RecursiveSolver

java.lang.Object
solvers.queueingnet.QNSolver
solvers.queueingnet.RecursiveSolver
All Implemented Interfaces:
QNSolverInterface
Direct Known Subclasses:
ConvolutionSolver, RECALNonRecursiveSolver, RECALSolver
public class RecursiveSolver extends QNSolver
This class implements the RecursiveSolver object, which contains common methods for the Convolution and RECAL algorithms.
Author:
Michail Makaronidis, 2010
